speaker: Doctor
text: The physical exam shows a bruit over the epigastric area and CT confirms reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries, which combined with your recent myocardial infarction and bloody stools strongly suggests ischemic bowel. Given your low blood pressure, are you currently experiencing any chest pain, shortness of breath, or dizziness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain. I also have Bloody loose bowel movements, No vomiting, Sudden onset.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Bowel (Acute Mesenteric Ischemia). The patient's history of recent myocardial infarction, combined with the CT findings of reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries, hypotension, and bloody stools, confirms this diagnosis. Immediate surgical consultation and hemodynamic stabilization are required.
